name: xsolla-ai-kit
description: Xsolla agent skills toolkit — one entry point (shop-setup) that builds a game shop end to end: a shared foundation (merchant setup, catalog, Login/NewID, webhooks) then a choice of build path — headless (custom self-hosted storefront + Headless Checkout SDK) or Shop Builder (hosted, no-code storefront).

interface.shortDescription: Guided Xsolla workflows from zero to a live game shop
interface.longDescription: One entry point, two build paths. shop-setup runs the shared foundation (merchant-setup, catalog-design, login-setup, webhooks-impl) then routes to either the headless path (headless-storefront, headless-login, headless-checkout-integration) for a custom self-hosted store, or the Shop Builder path (shopbuilder-storefront + site/page/blocks/customize/custom-block) for a hosted, no-code store.
